effects_provenance.raw: Zoap THCA Flower Essential / 28g (Smalls) Strain Profile Zoap THCA Flower is a balanced hybrid crafted from the cross of Rainbow Sherbet and Pink Guava . The genetics deliver vibrant, colorful buds with the kind of clean, herbal-soap aromatic signature that gave Zoap its name — instantly recognizable, structurally premium, and a foundational genetic in many modern crosses. Effects Zoap delivers a euphoric, uplifting onset paired with relaxed, body-easy effects. The high feels social and creative-leaning — suitable for daytime conversations, light tasks, or evening unwinding without committing to heavy sedation. A versatile cultivar that lives up to its modern reputation. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet floral notes up front, with a creamy sherbet-and-guava middle and a clean, slightly soapy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and uniquely contrasting — the herbal-clean signature is what defines this cultivar. The terpene profile reads floral-and-clean — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Zoap harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Zoap THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Zoap THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains.
